description:
## Goal
Remove repeated clean-ancestor traversal from rooted witness alternate-parent selection, preserving exact reachability and cycle rejection. Relevant membership edits should cost the actual changed branches plus necessary shared-path proof, not branch count times shared depth.

## Baseline evidence
Read-only inspection of ad0ac47d3 src/compiler2/pull/rooted.rs confirms RootedProducts::remove_edge filters every alternate candidate through below(candidate, removed_child); below follows parents to the seed independently each time. This predates48. No dedicated reparent/ancestor-performance ticket was found in bw search.
Production-reachable shape through the existing OwnershipProducers drive seam: retain S0→...→SD=T; T includes A1...AK and each Ai includes Ci. Settle, then add T→B where B includes every Ci and settle, preserving Ci witnesses under Ai. Leave prefix/T/B current; invalidate Ai,Ci and packaging P, and replace every Ai membership with empty. Each Ai completion repairs Ci to B. For each child, below(B,Ci) traverses the same D+2 clean nodes, giving K*(D+2) checks. This is a source-derived count, not a completed instrumented runtime RED.

## Scope and dependency boundary
48 separately introduced an admission-time ancestry scan on the same shape. That NEW cost is a48 blocker and cannot be deferred here. This ticket owns the preexisting below/alternate-selection work only, after48 lands; if48 naturally removes it, retain only the necessary remaining proof/docs rather than duplicate machinery. Keep existing typed deterministic alternate choice unless evidence permits a semantic-preserving simplification. No identity/display-string shortcuts, independent graph authority or permanent clearance cache.

## TDD and acceptance
- Pin the real retained drive shape at D=K8/32/64 before changing the baseline seam. Count all candidate checks and ancestor visits over the entire membership-repair request; keep them distinct from48 admission/cursor work.
- Preserve alternate support, cycle rejection, detach/reattach, seed reachability, unaffected branch retention and exact owner withdrawal. Add a back-edge alternate that must not retain an unsupported cycle.
- Demonstrate shared-prefix work is not multiplied by K, with unchanged/unrelated requests doing no new work. No shifted work hidden in uncounted upkeep or new per-request graph scan.
- Preserve healthy semantic outputs, generations, allocations where equal, and byte-identical backend/CLIF artifacts; inspect all causal-work differences without offsetting increases elsewhere.
- Collapse or reuse existing witness proof mechanics when possible; remove superseded scanner/helper and temporary instrumentation after the cutover. Coherent docs, implementation subagent, ticket-scoped cold review, one commit/close and prior-CI-gated push.

This is a required epic-tail issue, not authorization to leave48 regressions in place.

## Implementation-boundary research
Selected from bw ready after49 commit/close/push because higher-priority53 awaits the explicit duplicate-type source policy. Base is9a66849631f6e4a92650445bb360bbc6831e0315; three unrelated untracked measurement paths were preserved.49 exact CI34036595774 subsequently succeeded, clearing the predecessor push gate.

At the RED boundary, root reread the rooted witness implementation and docs. The preexisting scanner was: RootedProducts::remove_edge filters each alternate through below(candidate,key), which walks candidate parents independently.48s sparse DirtyWitness/active-prefix index accelerates dirty-demand traversal and admission; it is not a general ancestry authority and does not answer clean alternate cycle checks.51 must not repurpose sparse dirty state as full reachability. Existing typed semantic minimum and transactional add-before-remove behavior remain current contracts.

Open-PR inventory was rechecked. Only stacked base PR110 overlaps fact-engine documentation; its headc2c723c63afdbda22078bb0a164cb313b8c7dfa8 is already an ancestor. No other open PR touches rooted.rs/rooted tests or the two relevant docs, so there is no concordant source implementation to import.

The implementation boundary required first producing a genuine current-base RED through the retained OwnershipProducers/drive seam at D=K8/32/64, with separately observed candidate checks and ancestor visits and exact semantic controls passing before the work bound. Investigate the actual completion boundary before choosing cache lifetime: a solution scoped too narrowly to one remove_edge is insufficient if the repeated shared prefix spans multiple committed members. Prefer deriving cycle safety from the existing witness tree or a transient proof that is invalidated exactly by reparenting; do not add a retained ancestor graph/index, global scan, display identity, blanket cache, or shifted uncounted upkeep. Retain below only if the exact nonleaf fallback still requires it; remove temporary probes after cutover. The implementation subagent owned source/tests/docs only; root retained measurements, bw/index/commit/close/push and independent proof. A fresh ticket-cold review was required before landing.

## Genuine current-base RED
The unchanged production algorithm was exercised through the retained OwnershipProducers drive seam. Immutable failing log: /tmp/fz-tfn51-prefix-red.log; PTY session 98670; exit 101; RED diff SHA-256 87102237af28ec0210a232ffdb3450fb7d917f181a52c87767c4c1a061c0baf1. Observed (depth=width, candidates, ancestor visits, required bound): (8,8,80,56), (32,32,1088,200), (64,64,4224,392). Before the final work assertion failed, the test proved the existing48 admission bound, one evaluation and stable generation per affected owner and child, stable prefix/alternate Rc dependencies, exact obsolete owner membership/support withdrawal, and unchanged/unrelated zero repair work. Exactly K committed-owner repair reports prove the repeated scans span K ordinary ProductCompletion::Single completions inside one real drive; remove_edge-local or completion-local caching is insufficient. The instrumentation is causal and the production algorithm remains unchanged at this RED boundary.

Before production implementation, extend the RED with an asymmetric long reused-candidate path and stale-proof invalidation. The final model must remove repeated shared proof work beyond the symmetric fixture, account for all proof construction/invalidation/upkeep, retain an independent simple randomized oracle, and must not trade the old walk for hidden hashing, cloning, allocation, broad scans, or a second ancestry authority.

## Approved construction after RED
The reproduced production shape removes witness leaves. The existing children reverse witness relation proves, in one lookup, that a distinct reached candidate cannot be below a leaf; candidate==key remains explicitly rejected. Implement that exact leaf proof, keep the typed minimum, and retain the current parent-chain fallback for nonleaf removals. Count the leaf-index inspection and every fallback parent visit. This is the preferred cut because it removes all measured51 quadratic work, including long and alternating alternate branches, without cache lifetime, invalidation, allocation, cloning, subtree traversal, detached reconstruction, or another ancestry authority. Add direct self-loop and nonleaf cyclic/stale controls plus an independent simple parent-chain oracle. Do not claim that nonleaf shared prefixes are amortized here.

The generalized nonleaf shared-prefix problem and the independently exposed48 long-alternate admission problem are concordant remaining witness-proof work and are both owned by required tail ticket fz-tfn.56. This is not an omission from the epic:56 blocks the final CI ticket.51 must leave no temporary bridge for it.

## Final accepted candidate
Final seven-path tracked source/docs diff SHA-256 1ae48b2ebccf65631717bd3f77d4adead63f6caa9945b7f1c1241ee7219a37eb; root record .agent/measurements/fz-tfn51-validation.md SHA-256 8afa5aa495104802179105090305514ab1a9d955c4790862332b3ded5e3c960f is the eighth intended path. Focused111, compiler1962/0/6 existing ignored, runtime default-parallel214, serial matrix537, CLI30, AOT1, workspace docs, strict Clippy, repository/explicit formatting and diff checks all pass. Immutable final binary /tmp/fz-tfn51-final.wYwiRE/fz2 SHA-256 0780fd56048f928ef37ff21d2fe90192d4ed127547a9947cbc0b92f03487ff02. Root independent old/final six-door proof preserves every golden, all job/request/evaluation/settlement families, body walks, native functions/bytes and byte-identical backend/CLIF artifacts; representative fixtures have no alternate repair, so no whole-fixture speedup is claimed. Twelve real-drive shapes reduce cycle proof from up to 16640 old parent visits to exact K=8/32/64 child-index proof nodes with exact K/2K candidate inspections and zero unchanged/unrelated work. Ticket-cold source/docs review and final factual measurement review accept with no remaining finding. Preceding49 CI34036595774 is SUCCESS. Committed, closed and pushed as40563eeb756636153df0aac67d01940864fe2556 after the format/check/strict-Clippy hook passed. Exact own-head CI34038513373 succeeded for 40563eeb756636153df0aac67d01940864fe2556: lint and the full serialized coverage/test job are green. The successor push gate is cleared. Required tail56 retains the distinct long-alternate admission and generalized nonleaf amortization work.
